title: Universe-polymorphic lifting consequence of adic formal smoothness
statement: For any universe z, if h : FormallySmoothAdic R S n and D : Type z is a commutative R-algebra, then every square-zero lifting problem S →ₐ[R] D ⧸ J killing a positive power of n admits an R-algebra lift.

source.place: More on Algebra, Definition 15.38.1 (Tag 07EB) and the lifting argument of Lemma 07EG

proof.text: Choose representatives b(s) in D of each g(s). Form the R-subalgebra A generated by them and the ideal K = J ∩ A. The inclusion A → D is injective, so J² = 0 implies K² = 0. The induced map j : A/K → D/J is injective and its image contains g(S). Factor g uniquely through j to obtain g₀; injectivity preserves the given power-vanishing witness.

Evaluation from R[X_s | s ∈ S] surjects onto A. Its quotient by the evaluation kernel is an R-algebra model A₀ : Type (max u v) isomorphic to A. Transport K and g₀ to this model and apply the defining lifting property h there.
Compose the lift S → A₀ with the isomorphism to A and the inclusion A → D. Its quotient composite is j ∘ g₀ = g.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07EB lifting definition; the size-reduction argument via a polynomial presentation is written by J2, not claimed to be stated in Stacks
